references.text: He satisfies the longing soul, and fills the hungry soul with good things.

All you who are thirsty, come to the waters! And you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price. Why do you spend your silver for what is not bread, and your labor for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and eat what is good, and let your soul delight itself in rich food.
I will fill the priests with abundance, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says the Lord.
But blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God. Blessed are you who hunger now, for you shall be filled.
The story of the rich man and Lazarus, where the rich man lived in luxury on earth but suffered in Hades, while Lazarus, who suffered on earth, was comforted in Abraham's bosom.
